installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g'))
else
	MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(echo "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | tr -d ' ' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
	UA="YuraCloud-Optix/1.0.0 (dapa@dapaproject.my.id)"

	if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then
		MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r '[.versions | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("1.")) | .value[] | select(contains("-") | not)] | .[0]')
	else
		VER_EXISTS=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r --arg VERSION "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '[.versions[][] | select(. == $VERSION)] | .[0]')
		if [ -z "${VER_EXISTS}" ] || [ "${VER_EXISTS}" = "null" ]; then
			MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r '[.versions | to_entries[] | select(.key | startswith("1.")) | .value[] | select(contains("-") | not)] | .[0]')
		fi
	fi

	if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
		BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -r '.builds | max')
		echo -e "Using latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	else
		BUILD_EXISTS=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -r --argjson BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds[] | select(. == $BUILD)' | grep -m1 .)
		if [ -z "${BUILD_EXISTS}" ] || [ "${BUILD_EXISTS}" = "null" ]; then
			BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -r '.builds | max')
		fi
	fi

	DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url // .downloads[].url' | head -n1)
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "[YuraCloud] Mengunduh Paper ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} (Build ${BUILD_NUMBER})..."

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
	mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

if ! curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
	echo -e "[YuraCloud] ERROR: Gagal mengunduh server jar dari ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
	exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
	curl -4 -fsSL -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

mkdir -p YuraCloud/data

if [ "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" = "auto" ] || [ -z "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" ]; then
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated"
elif echo "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" | grep -qE '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'; then
	RESTART_TIME="${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}"
	RESTART_MODE="Admin-defined"
else
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated (invalid time)"
fi

echo "Server akan restart otomatis pada jam $RESTART_TIME WIB" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart.txt
echo "inactive" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart_status.txt
echo "[INSTALL] Auto-restart schedule: $RESTART_TIME WIB ($RESTART_MODE)" >> YuraCloud/data/restart.log

echo -e "[YuraCloud] Instalasi selesai dengan sukses!"
